snippet.title: Company of Heroes 3 - Endure & Defy Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Company of Heroes 3: Endure & Defy launches November 27 and introduces four new Battlegroups, each bringing powerful units, abilities, and tactics to Multiplayer and Co-Op/Skirmish vs AI.

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4095900/Company_of_Heroes_3_Endure__Defy/
